name: openpixo/game-art-set
title: Matching game art set
description: Generate new sprites, props, tiles, icons, backgrounds and 3D concept images that match the game's style reference, using one style sheet and a fixed prompt template per asset family.

description_i18n.en: Generate new sprites, props, tiles, icons, backgrounds and 3D concept images that match the game's style reference, using one style sheet and a fixed prompt template per asset family.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 按游戏的风格参考图生成新的角色、道具、瓦片、图标、背景和 3D 概念图：一份风格说明，每类素材一个固定的提示词模板。

examples.title: Make one stage's art
examples.prompt: Make the stage 2 art from the style reference: the slime enemy, coin and key pickups, and a grass tile. List it with the credits first, then generate, review and wire it in.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 按风格参考图做第 2 阶段的美术：史莱姆敌人、金币和钥匙拾取物、一块草地瓦片。先列出清单和积分，再生成、检查并接进游戏。

examples.title: Write the style sheet
examples.prompt: Look at the style reference in concept/ and write art/style-sheet.md: the style line, what to avoid, the view, sizes and heights for the characters in the plan. Do not generate anything yet.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 看 concept/ 里的风格参考图，写出 art/style-sheet.md：风格句、要避免的东西、视角，以及计划里各角色的尺寸和身高比例。先不要生成任何图。

examples.title: Add an enemy variant
examples.prompt: Make a blue, twice-as-wide version of assets/enemies/slime.png that matches the rest of the game, then add it to level 3.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 做一个蓝色、宽一倍的 assets/enemies/slime.png 变体，和游戏里其他美术风格一致，然后放进第 3 关。
